s: ruin (something which leads to serious troubles)
Ruin.et: Borrowed from French ruine, from Latin ruīna. Doublet of Ruine.

s: to ruin (to destroy or make dysfunctional, e.g. of health, relationships or financially)
to ruin (to make unappealing or unenjoyable)
Das hat mir echt den ganzen Abend ruiniert.
That really ruined the whole evening for me.
ruinieren.et: Borrowed from French ruiner. Equivalent to Ruine or Ruin + -ieren.
